evidence.trustReason: Fresh-context review of packages/opencode/test/task/verify-spec-RM15.spec.ts (5 tests, 64 expect calls; my bun run: 5 pass, 0 fail, 78.5 s under load average 179). The test drives the real code: release-notes.spec through Blend.load and TaskCommand.plan (loadPlan), facts folded through TaskEngineXState.apply, readiness read five ways (work-region state from the snapshot value, the <id>:ready tag, RunSupervisor.supervised, TaskEngineXState.waitingOn, TaskStatus.project). No mocks. GIVEN the release-notes plan: test 1 asserts the loaded afterEffective and children (T1.3 after T1.1; T1.4 after T1.2, T1.3; T1.5 after T1.3, T1.4, T9; T1 parent of T1.1-T1.5) and the start state (T1.1, T1.2 ready; others waiting on named ids). WHEN T1.1 trusted and T1.2 not: test 2 asserts T1.1 machine state trusted and T1.2 in each of ready, building, proving, verifying. THEN T1.3 ready and T1.4 waiting: in each of those four cases T1.3 equals READY (machine ready, ready tag, supervised, waitingOn []) and T1.4 waits on exactly [T1.2, T1.3]; one fact before T1.1's verdict T1.3 still waits on T1.1; test 3 shows T1.4 needs both after tasks. AND parent T1 waits until every child is trusted: test 4 trusts the children one by one and asserts T1 waits on exactly the untrusted rest after each, and is READY only in the step that trusts the last child. AND stale dependency: test 5 applies obligation.stale to T1.1.c1 while T1.3 is READY; T1.1 goes to proving, the obligation shows stale, and T1.3 returns to waiting on T1.1 in the same fold step and is no longer supervised; a re-trust makes it ready again; the same holds for the ready parent T1 when T1.5.c1 goes stale. Every Gherkin step has specific, non-vacuous assertions.
